slides.headline: love weather: *venus* wants it, *mars* isn't ready
venus trines *saturn*: commit to something small
slides.body: astrologers read it as steady affection. a second date, a real plan, a text you'll stand by tomorrow.

slides.headline: venus squares a *retrograde* mars
slides.body: read it as chemistry with bad timing. you don't have to fix it tonight.

slides.headline: if it's one-sided, it isn't alignment. it's a *hobby*.
slides.body: your venus is how you love. it has to be mutual.
